lock_dir=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks
while ! mkdir "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done
lock_pid=$$
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$lock_pid" > "$lock_dir/pid"
log_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rev3-ajcr-verify.XXXXXX)
hash_before="$log_dir/hashes.before"
hash_after="$log_dir/hashes.after"
cleanup_rev3_lock() {
  if test -f "$lock_dir/pid" && test "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock_dir/pid")" = "$lock_pid"; then
    unlink "$lock_dir/pid"
    rmdir "$lock_dir"
  fi
}
trap cleanup_rev3_lock EXIT
files=(
  AlgebraicJacobian.lean
  AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/IdealSheafRelativeGluing.lean
  AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/RelativeCurveAffineCover.lean
  AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivisorFamilyAffBaseChange.lean
  probe_rev3_relative_gluing.lean
  probe_rev3_relative_cover.lean
  probe_rev3_regular_adaptation.lean
)
sha256sum "${files[@]}" > "$hash_before"
printf '"'LOG_DIR %s\\n' \""'$log_dir"
run_step() {
  label=$1

id: AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.datum-tail.abel-quotient
title: Admissible divisor quotient represents Pic0 (corrected Altman-Kleiman)
projects:

summary: 'Prove the single endpoint `noncomputable def pic0AdmissibleAbelQuotientRepresenter
  {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
  [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] : Sigma fun Q : Over (Spec (.of
  k)) => (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy Q`. Accepted only when the body directly
  consumes `divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy`, chooses the admissible Abel
  datum internally, and constructs in Scheme over Spec k an effective quotient of
  `divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C` by the kernel relation of the concrete admissible
  `chartValueAffTrans` or its `abelSigmaChartAff` form. Identify that kernel with
  the relative and etale-local linear-equivalence relation seen by `relPic` and `picEt`,
  including the `picFromBase` quotient; prove the admissible Abel transformation is
  locally surjective as an etale-sheaf map; and identify the quotient Yoneda functor
  with `pic0TypeFunctor C`. Establish the required quasi-projectivity or concrete
  project-local embedding. No equivalent Prop, class, structure, Nonempty, or existential
  reformulation; no projection wrapper; and no binder for RepresentableBy, IsRepresentable,
  HasSmoothProperQuotient, open-atlas coverage, rational points, local surjectivity,
  a kernel-pair representer, or quotient data counts as progress. The raw admissible
  Abel map only feeds this quotient: positive-dimensional linear-system fibres prevent
  it from being an open Pic0 atlas.'

    10	/-!
    11	# Base change of intrinsic divisor-family ideal sheaves
    12	
    13	This file identifies the intrinsic ideal sheaf attached to a widened affine divisor family
    14	with the pullback of that ideal sheaf under scalar extension.  The representative statement
    15	uses an explicit regularity witness; the quotient and explicit-algebra-map statements then
    16	follow from the established `DivFamZarAff` base-change API.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
    32	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    33	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R']
    34	  [IsScalarTower k R R']
    35	
    36	namespace Scheme.LocalEquations
    37	
    38	/-- Pulling a local-equation divisor along a relative-curve scalar extension pulls back its
    39	intrinsic Cartier ideal sheaf.  Regularity is supplied in exactly the form required by
    40	`Scheme.LocalEquations.pullback`; no certificate or projectivity hypothesis is used. -/
    41	theorem cartierIdealData_pullback_relCurveMap (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
    42	    (hreg : ∀ (y z : relCurve C R')
    43	      (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y),
    44	      ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
    45	        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) z hz).hom
    46	          (pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
    47	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z)) :
    48	    (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg).cartierIdealData =
    49	      d.cartierIdealData.comap (relCurveMap C R R') := by
    50	  letI : IsAffineHom (relCurveMap C R R') := Over.isAffineHom_cg C
    51	  obtain ⟨D, ⟨A⟩⟩ := exists_affAdaptation_of_isProper C R d
    52	  rw [(A.pullbackOfHreg R' hreg).cartierIdealData_eq_cartierIdeal,
    53	    A.cartierIdealData_eq_cartierIdeal]
    54	  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top
    55	    (fun j : D.index =>
    56	      ⟨(D.baseChange R').pieces j, (D.baseChange R').isAffineOpen j⟩)
    57	    (D.baseChange R').cover
    58	  intro j
    59	  rw [(A.pullbackOfHreg R' hreg).cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_span_eqn j,
    60	    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isAffineHom A.cartierIdeal
    61	      (relCurveMap C R R') ⟨D.pieces j, D.isAffineOpen j⟩,
    62	    A.cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_span_eqn j, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    63	    A.pullbackOfHreg_eqn]
    64	  change Ideal.span {((relCurveMap C R R').appLE (D.pieces j)
    65	      (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j) le_rfl).hom (A.eqn j)} =
    66	    Ideal.span {((relCurveMap C R R').app ⟨D.pieces j, D.isAffineOpen j⟩).hom
    67	      (A.eqn j)}
    68	  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]

    70	end Scheme.LocalEquations

    74	variable {n : ℕ}
    75	
    76	/-- The intrinsic Cartier ideal sheaf of a widened divisor-family class commutes with scalar
    77	extension along an algebra tower. -/
    78	theorem cartierIdealData_mapAlg (F : DivFamZarAff C R n) :
    79	    (mapAlg R' n F).cartierIdealData =
    80	      F.cartierIdealData.comap (relCurveMap C R R') := by
    81	  refine Quotient.inductionOn F ?_
    82	  rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
    83	  rw [mapAlg_mk, cartierIdealData_mk, cartierIdealData_mk]
    84	  exact d.cartierIdealData_pullback_relCurveMap R'
    85	    (hd.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' n)

    87	/-- The explicit algebra-map form of intrinsic Cartier ideal-sheaf base change. -/
    88	theorem cartierIdealData_mapAlgHom
    89	    {A A' : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A']
    90	    (φ : A →ₐ[k] A') (F : DivFamZarAff C A n) :
    91	    (mapAlgHom φ F).cartierIdealData =
    92	      letI : Algebra A A' := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    93	      haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' :=
    94	        .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm
    95	      F.cartierIdealData.comap (relCurveMap C A A') := by
    96	  letI : Algebra A A' := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    97	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' :=
    98	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm
    99	  rw [mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg φ (fun _ => rfl)]
   100	  exact cartierIdealData_mapAlg A' F
